title: Console Orientation Compass: unified dashboard anchors & lightweight workspace flyover
creator: Lina Chen
description: Problem: The current console navigation is fragmented across multiple rail patterns and workspace switches, causing users to lose context when moving between dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. Goals: 1) Provide a single, lightweight orientation surface (Compass) that anchors the current dashboard, rollout context, and active cost-lens. 2) Introduce a non-disruptive workspace flyover for quick switching without full page navigation. 3) Surface rollout state hints and cost-impact badges inline with routes. Scope: prototype IA flows for the left nav compact state, Compass modal/flyover, small-screen behavior, and dashboard anchors. Non-goals: full visual redesign, telemetry backend implementation, or RBAC changes (those are follow-up tickets).
design_notes: Compass is a transient, role-aware overlay that appears from the left-rail collapse area and shows: current workspace, recent dashboards, pinned rollouts, and active cost-lens toggles.
Workspace flyover is keyboard-first and accessible: focuses the first actionable item, supports type-to-filter, and preserves route state on dismiss.
Cost-lens badges show per-route unit-cost delta; tiny tooltip explains batching/quantization trade-offs with link to cost settings.
Rollout hints display simple banners in the Compass when a route has an ongoing canary/A-B rollout; secondary actions allow 'view rollout' and 'revert to stable'.

acceptance_criteria: Accessible Compass overlay that reveals from collapsed left-rail and lists at least 5 recent dashboards.
Workspace flyover that allows switching workspaces without full page reload in prototype (client-side state preserved).
Cost-lens badges visible on dashboard routes with tooltip copy and link to cost settings doc.
Rollout hint banners surface for routes with active canary/A-B experiments and provide 'view rollout' CTA.
Figma prototype handed off with developer specs and a short recording showing keyboard flows.
accessibility_considerations: High priority: ensure overlay is announced via ARIA live region, trap focus while open, provide high-contrast badges, and provide text alternatives for cost-lens icons. Test with screen readers and keyboard-only navigation.
